source_note: The subject is the frozen staged feature, not clean HEAD. Later HEAD fast-forward to merged main5f8add8 had the identical base tree and preserved the staged tree byte-for-byte. Publication metadata is separate.
changes: Use actual CPAL0.18.2 typed PCM callbacks and existing dasp conversions for twelve frontend sample types; reject DSD/future formats before the builder.
Keep existing ordered float32 mixing bit-identical; preserve first/last complete frames, bounded packet/queue/mute/stop behavior and checked sequence/timestamp metadata.
Reject malformed frames through existing error counters; preserve selected device/default config, native Windows/system capture, model settings and the current resampler/Endpoint assertions.
retained_preparation_failure: Private first patch-preparation assertion stopped before any mutation when a closing hunk marker was selected; line-start hunk parsing corrected it. No build/test failure or product result is inferred.
checks_not_run: No physical microphone/driver/backend negotiation, permissions, Bluetooth/route changes or realtime native callback scheduling.
Twelve typed frontend arms do not establish physical format support: available formats still depend on backend and device.
No new ASR/inference accuracy, echo/drift, sustained resource/power, GUI/window or reference comparison.
Command times include compilation; they are not callback/capture or answer latency.
Windows/Linux native runtime and release acceptance remain separate; default/device selection never silently changes.
full_goal: All eight workstreams/73 contracts/12 acceptance families remain active; no feature state or tolerance is promoted.
